messages:
priya: alert: sudden p99 token latency spike in apac1 ~03:12 UTC. spike coincides with several model migrations into dedicated-apac1. net graphs show per-rack egress queue saturation. https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/egress/apac1

omar: confirming. 10 tenants migrated in parallel due to auto-assign fallback after zone drain. their prefill traffic is hammering the NICs.

jen: mitigation: can we flip dedicated-apac1.accepts_cross_region_prefill=false and shift migrations to best-effort for 30m?

priya: doing that now. `poolctl edit dedicated-apac1 --set accepts_cross_region_prefill=false`

infra-bot: action: pool config updated for dedicated-apac1 at 1975312380 by priya 

omar: also throttled inter-node egress on those racks with `tc` shim to 100mbit temporarily. command: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 100mbit burst 64kb latency 50ms`

jen: good. after throttle p99 dropped from 620ms -> 180ms in 90s. tenant error rates unchanged.

priya: created INFRA-8010 to add a safety admission-check: disallow migrations to dedicated pools if node.egress_util > 70% OR pool.util > 85%. assigning to omar. https://jira.redwood/INFRA-8010

omar: taking it. plan: 1) admission webhook that rejects ambiguous selectors 2) pool-level egress quota as soft-limit 3) telemetry alert on pool-egress-saturation

finance: FYI cross-rack migrations bumped our inter-region egress estimate by ~$2.4k this month if repeated. tagging for visibility.

jen: follow-ups: omar to implement webhook (ETA 48h), priya to run a selector audit (ETA EOD), infra-bot to add alert for pool-egress-saturation > 5m.

infra-bot: follow-up reminder scheduled: 1975398745 (24h) for INFRA-8010

priya: lesson: auto-assign fallback must respect pool egress headroom. adding that constraint to the auto-assign policy now.

omar: will post PR for webhook + tests. small CI test to simulate label collisions included.

jen: thanks team. leaving this thread open until INFRA-8010 is closed.
